messages:
Asha: Repro summary: after hosted key rotation some private adapters got 401s for ~20-30s. Push notifications didn't reach all sidecars. Need a clear contract: does CP push rotations or do adapters pull/validate a signed lease?

Ben: Quick take: CP should be authoritative for rotations in hosted flow, but adapters must be able to operate offline. Hybrid contract seems necessary.

Liu: Hybrid works. Propose signed-lease that CP signs (adapter_id, tenant_id, exp, nonce) so adapters can validate locally when offline. Include key-id header for sig verification.

Ravi: Operational pain point: adapters retried aggressively and triggered rate limits. Must add client-side exponential backoff and a server-side tenant degradation threshold.

SRE-Leah: Ops rules: instrument auth.rebind_attempts, auth.rebind_failures, auth.rebind_backoff_seconds. If failures >5 in 1m mark tenant degraded and route to fallback model. Also provide a 'suppress-rotations' CLI to pause rotations for affected tenants.

Asha: Security notes: leases must be bound to adapter identity and audience to prevent replay across tenants. TTL: default 300s but configurable; don't hardcode too short.

Ben: Config sketch for adapter:
```
adapter.auth_mode: hybrid # push | pull | hybrid
adapter.signed_lease_ttl_s: 300
adapter.max_rebinds_per_min: 5
adapter.local_kms: http://127.0.0.1:8200
```
Default hybrid + 300s.

Liu: Edge-case: KV cache and in-flight requests. Plan: make tokens request-scoped where possible; otherwise perform a short drain window during swap and flush per-tenant KV entries. Document SLO impact (small window).

Ravi: Thundering herd mitigation idea: adapter sets header `X-Rebind-State: in-progress` while swapping so proxies can suppress concurrent retries. Also add randomized jitter on renew attempts.

Asha: Action items: Ben+Liu draft RFC comparing push vs pull with signed-lease spec and key-id rotation plan. SRE-Leah draft metrics + runbook. Ravi file adapter config PR with defaults. ops-bot: run unit/integration checks.
